This is irritable bowel syndrome, which involves the colon. The sympathetic preganglionic neurons for these viscera originate in the intermediolateral cell column (lateral horn) of the thoracolumbar spinal cord, about T10–L2. Midgut fibers (to the mid-transverse colon) leave via the lesser and least thoracic splanchnic nerves (T10–T11) to the superior mesenteric ganglion, and hindgut fibers leave via the lumbar splanchnic nerves (L1–L2) to the inferior mesenteric ganglion.

CONFIDENCE: 80
